Collection.description:
Protocol-tagged collection descriptor. The `protocol` tag discriminates the variant, leaving room
for `snmp` and other protocols without reshaping the envelope.

encoding.description: Recommended encoding for subscriptions, chosen from the endpoint's advertised encodings.

gnmi_version.description: gNMI protocol version the endpoint advertised, when reported.

suggested_subscriptions.description: Subscriptions matched from the advertised models that a collector can stream.

supported_models.description: YANG models the endpoint advertised support for.

ProfileConfidence.description:
How much the profile can be trusted. v1 is always `advertised_only`: the models and any suggested
subscriptions are derived from the endpoint's advertised capabilities, not verified against it.

address.description: IP address the endpoint answered on.

ScanMetadata.description: Per-scan provenance stamped on every emitted record. `scan_id` is a ULID; consumers can sort and correlate records by it.

initiated_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of when the scan started.

scenario_name.description: Name of the scenario that produced this scan; absent (null) for an unnamed scenario.

source_config_hash.description: `sha256:…` digest of the canonicalized scenario config that produced this scan.

Subscription.description: A recommended gNMI subscription a collector can stream, matched from the device's advertised models.

matched_model.description: Advertised model this subscription was matched from.

sample_interval_ns.description: Absent (null) for on-change or target-defined modes.

Transport.description: Wire transport an endpoint answered over: `tls` for an encrypted channel, `plaintext` for `http`/2.

description:
How to collect telemetry from a discovered endpoint: the endpoint that answered, the confidence
in the profile, and a protocol-tagged `collection` descriptor. One record per gNMI endpoint, so a
device with two management endpoints yields two profiles sharing an `identity_key`.

collection.description: Protocol-tagged descriptor of what to collect and how.

endpoint.description: The endpoint that returned the capability data.

identity_key.description: Identity of the device this profile belongs to; shared across the device's endpoints.

note.description: Optional human-readable note about the profile; omitted when unset.

observed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of when the capability data was observed.

scan_metadata.description: Provenance stamped by the pipeline at scan entry.

schema_id.description: URL of the JSON Schema this record conforms to — the same value as this schema's `$id`.

schema_version.description: Schema version tag; `v1` for records emitted by this build. Versioned independently of the device record.

title: CollectionProfileRecord
